purpose: Deliberate over-acquisition focused on the remaining hard gaps: raw per-cycle process histories, natural wear, hot-runner actual/control evidence, multicavity outcomes, cooling, cross-machine transfer, material variation and multimaterial moulding. Public/raw visibility never implies redistribution rights, and same-program records retain overlap families.

sources.name: imPURE PASCOE injection-moulding raw sensor data — 17 May 2022 trial
sources.reportedAccess: Zenodo record describes open-access data from the PASCOE injection-moulding line.
sources.value: High-value raw repeated-cycle process family with explicit cycle identity and stage/label companion files.
sources.nextAction: Retrieve metadata/file manifest, verify licence, fingerprint cycle files, profile columns/time base and determine exact cycle count/label semantics.

sources.name: imPURE PASCOE injection-moulding raw sensor data — 16 May 2022 trial
sources.reportedAccess: EU data catalogue describes open-access PASCOE injection-moulding-line data.
sources.value: Companion production day for within-family repeatability/drift checks; must not count as an independent machine family from MM-DATA-133.

sources.name: C-P-T multisensor cross-machine / cross-material anomaly diagnosis study
sources.value: Directly addresses machine/material transfer rather than single-cell accuracy.

sources.name: 16-cavity / 34-pressure-sensor multicavity imbalance experiment
sources.dataAvailability: Data available on request from corresponding author.
sources.value: Strong cavity-by-cavity pressure/weight family for imbalance and mould-state interpretation.

sources.name: 16-cavity / 30-pressure-sensor injection-moulding quality-prediction experiment
sources.value: Additional multicavity pressure-to-quality experiment; likely overlaps institutional tooling/program with MM-DATA-136 and must not be counted independently without experiment-level review.

sources.name: Hot-runner thin-wall adaptive quality-control experiment
sources.reportedTool: two-cavity 0.35 mm thin-wall hot-runner cream-box mould
sources.verifiedOutcome: Adaptive control reduced reported product-weight variation from 0.819% to 0.677% and standard deviation from 0.0200 g to 0.0178 g.
sources.dataAvailability: Available on request from corresponding author.

sources.name: Two-cavity hot-runner cavity-pressure iterative-learning-control experiment
sources.reportedTool: two-cavity hot-runner mould with a pressure sensor in each cavity
sources.dataAvailability: Authors state all data are available on request.
sources.value: Independent industrial hot-runner pressure-control family distinct from the BJ368MO thin-wall study.

sources.name: KaskaRe servo-electric hot-runner valve-pin pressure-control project
sources.value: Targets the currently rare actual hot-runner actuation -> cavity-pressure relationship.

sources.name: 2026 multi-stage adaptive injection-process adjustment study
sources.dataAvailability: Publisher reports data available on request.
sources.value: Shot-to-adjustment evidence with online process indexes and physical quality outcomes.

sources.name: LEGO five-grade dual-sourcing cycle-mass control experiment
sources.reportedMaterials: five ABS materials from different vendors/grades
sources.verifiedOutcome: Cycle-mass feedback reduced overall part-mass variance by about 50% and length/width variance by about 40% versus fixed settings.
sources.dataAvailability: Underlying datasets unavailable publicly for commercial reasons; requests directed to corresponding author.
sources.value: Excellent material-source change -> control action -> recovered dimensional/mass consistency case.

sources.name: LEGO dynamic nozzle-pressure model and controller validation dataset target
sources.dataAvailability: Underlying datasets unavailable publicly for commercial reasons; requests directed to corresponding author.
sources.value: Useful actual process-control dynamics but shares LEGO/AAU hardware lineage with MM-DATA-142, so independence must be conservative.

sources.name: Measured-sensor-assisted injection-mould cooling digital twin
sources.articleAccess: open access under a Creative Commons licence
sources.verifiedOutcome: Reported real-time 3D temperature profile matched simulation within approximately 1 C at ejection time.
sources.value: Independent cooling-state evidence beyond coolant flow alone; raw sensor/source-data route still needs extraction/review.

sources.name: High-volume injection-mould core-insert service-life experiment
sources.dataAvailability: Authors state raw supporting data will be made available on request.
sources.value: Naturalistic tool-life evidence directly aligned with maintenance lifecycle monitoring.

sources.name: Industrial injection-mould predictive-maintenance edge-device dataset target
sources.reportedContext: Real injection-mould manufacturing system with intelligent-edge condition monitoring.
sources.dataAvailability: Dataset is confidential company manufacturing information and not publicly available.
sources.value: High-value owner-authorisation target for natural operational maintenance evidence; article access does not license underlying data.

sources.name: Precision ejector-pin-hole wear evolution experiment
sources.reportedProtocol: Wear volume and surface morphology measured every 100,000 friction cycles using white-light interferometry/3D point clouds.
sources.reportedValidation: Wear-volume calculation validated against public datasets with less than 2% relative error.
sources.value: Direct quantified ejector-interface wear progression, complementary to process-level extraction-force monitoring.

sources.name: Micro-Fresnel injection-mould tool wear over 24,500 production cycles
sources.reportedOutcome: After 24,500 cycles, 23 micrometre ribs showed roughly 400-1000 nm height reduction and coating structural failure/craters were observed.
sources.value: Rare true longitudinal production-wear series for an injection-mould insert.

sources.name: AlCrN-coated relay mould service-life production comparison
sources.reportedDesign: Four coated and four uncoated two-cavity relay mould specimens under matched production conditions.
sources.value: Very strong quantitative wear -> flash -> failure threshold evidence over tens of thousands of real moulding cycles.

sources.name: SLA rapid-tooling mould lifetime and ejector-wear experiment
sources.reportedOutcome: After an initial 30-sample campaign, the higher-temperature resin insert produced flash at the ejector-pin tip after an additional 25 cycles; continued cycling worsened flash until extraction failed.
sources.value: Small-scale but clear wear -> flash -> loss-of-extraction lifecycle case.

sources.name: 2026 cross-machine quality-prediction transfer-learning experiment
sources.reportedFinding: High target-machine prediction performance was reported using 60% of the target machine data.
sources.value: Independent cross-machine quality-transfer family, directly addressing the current generalisation gap.

sources.name: UHMWPE/HDPE two-component fabric-insert injection-moulding experiment
sources.dataAvailability: Datasets generated/analyzed are available from the corresponding author on reasonable request.
sources.value: Additional multimaterial/insert-moulding family distinct from PP/LSR, polymer-metal and CF-PEEK overmoulding.

sources.name: Hot-runner virgin/recycled polypropylene structure-property experiment
sources.value: Independent hot-runner + recyclate material family that complements pressure-control studies with physical structure/property outcomes.

sources.name: 2026 multi-cavity fishbone-runner optimisation dataset target
sources.dataAvailability: Supporting data available from corresponding author upon reasonable request.
sources.value: Lower-priority because it is optimisation/model heavy, but useful runner-system evidence if measured validation data can be isolated.

sources.name: 90,000-cycle industrial injection-mould coating wear experiment
sources.reportedProcess: Industrial Krauss-Maffei mould producing glass-fibre-reinforced PP parts.
sources.value: True industrial long-cycle abrasive-tool-wear evidence independent of relay-mould and micro-optics studies.

sources.name: Injection-mould steel hardness-loss / thermal-wear experiment
sources.reportedFinding: A drastic hardness loss was observed after approximately 200 injection cycles in the tested powder-metallurgical steel, with viscous-dissipation heating investigated as the mechanism.
sources.value: Adds a distinct thermal/material degradation mode to the mould-wear lifecycle evidence.

sources.name: 45,000-cycle coated-mould wear experiment for glass-fibre PP
sources.reportedFinding: Industrial tests reported large wear-resistance improvements for TiAlSiN and CrN/CrCN/DLC coated samples relative to uncoated tool steel.
sources.value: Additional independent long-cycle mould-wear family for coating/tool-life generalisation.
